Our Alchemist Union brings up many junior alchemists with various promotions and investigations.
They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
It looks like you are an expert in this field, how about meeting other geneticists?
Not long ago there was a Geneticist who announced a sensational new life studying research.
You are very knowledgeable. Do you think you might understand her work?
Her study may help you gain the knowledge to help you make a Geneticist!
How's that sound? Do you want to meet a Geneticist?
Of course, I want to meet a Geneticist.
I don't want to meet a Geneticist.
You can find her in the Alchemy Lab at the western part of Lighthalzen. There is also another Geneticist studying weaponry there, you might want to pay her a visit as well.
Aren't you interested in the study of life?
The infamous Geneticist is studying at the Alchemy Lab in the western part of Lighthalzen.
If you are interested, go meet with her.
Our Alchemist Union brings up many junior alchemists with various promotions and investigations.
They have spread to all corners of Midgard and were active in many fields like sciences or special item production methods.
We call the members of our new union ^3131FF'Geneticists'^000000.
Geneticists are the ones who have reached their peak potential in the world of Alchemy. They are the ones who currently spearhead alchemy throughout all of Midgard.
- You still have some unused skill points. -
Oh! The bloodsucking plant sample C is withering again.
Should I change the ingredient of the growth care?
Your look tells me that you are doing Alchemy as well right?
People say the number of alchemists is increasing nowadays though there aren't may who study this field properly!
They're all too worried about saying things like, ''Look at my bomb damage!'' or ''isn?t my homunculus prettier?''
The Alchemist Union was saying they'd support the researchers but actually what you get from the studying is just 'Spores Which Can Be Easily Raised'!
Thanks to that, there are spores everywhere in my lab! There are spores everywhere!
Why do you talk like that?
Have you ever been to Rune-Midgarts? Everyone in Rune-Midgarts speaks like this.
Do you come from a Rune-Midgarts village?
My village is very big, everyone there speaks like this.
Really! That's why I felt some kind of familiar atmosphere around you.
Meeting a hometown person in Schwarzwald, it's my pleasure to meet you!
That's the sound of an experiment being carried out by my roommate, Demi Calberine..
Demi's a fire shell technician so she's always noisy like that.
My spores and plants are all freaked out!
I can't do my work with those noisy sounds. It gives me so much stress!!
When I don't feel good, I savor Mr. Orlean's handmade cookies little by little.
It's a high-quality cookie that I got from Prontera. When I get one bite, it seems like I'm floating to Asgard.
The softness of the sweet cookie drowns out the clashing sounds from Demi Calberine.
Ah, I've eaten all of it.
But it's okay! On the 2nd floor of my room, there are boxes of those!
I couldn't stop buying it all in bulk. Ho ho ho.
- For now it seems that I -
Ah, The sweet buttery taste remains at the end of my tongue.
This really gives me peace of mind.
Demi is studying hard today as well
Huhuhu. She's really a hard worker.
- That cookie changed her mood quick. -
You came here with a love for Alchemy?
Oh wait, We haven't introduced ourselves yet.
I'm very interested in making living things that show new and peculiar growth.
That's a very unusual name. Pleased to meet you.
But I can't memorize the name well.
So I'll just call you <Popo>. Would that be ok?
Popo, have you heard of my research?
You came here because of that, am I right?
Well, it's all over your face.
You don't have to be shy.
Well, as I expected, there really is something that makes homeland people get each other
When you saw me in that feverish state, you remembered what I said before and that calmed me down.
I like the way you manage yourself and take care to remember small details.
You have the talent to become a Geneticist.
^FF0000If you become a Geneticist, you can't take the Alchemist's or Biochemist study course that you haven't investigated before.^000000
If that's all right for you, how about giving it a shot right now?.
I want to become a Geneticist!
Even though your knowledge is not that great as that of Geneticists, a fundamental knowledge is also important.
Popo, come back to me once you've finished your studies.
Are you ready to give it a shot?
You have to do your best! There is no easy way when looking for knowledge!
What do you think of plants, Popo
Do you like plants? What kind of plants are you interested in?
Ah, please tell me Demi Calberine is not starting again?
Please let my expectation be wrong ... Please... Demi, please...
Oh, right. Plants are very important in Alchemy.
Alchemy can make Flora's and Geographers grow immensely fast, so they can help in battle, like those Alchemists...
Techniques, plants are relatively easy to...
I'll give you the test to become a Geneticist.
The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calberine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
The subject is <The Perfect Soundproof System>!
Please think of a way to save me from Demi Calbereine's noise, using plants and experimental equipment that are here on the 1st floor of the lab.
There are some guides in the cabinet that you may use.
Better get started, or I'll start to scream!!!
You can start from the beginning then?
Why are you asking me such things?
What the hell is Demi Calberine doing?
How could you say the study is completed without any result?
Well, I'll take a look at the seeds Popo made.
When you put a seed in a Super Cultivator, and adjust the temperature...
The inside of the Cultivator is now full of thorny stems!
It's as if the stems are making a wall and growing very sturdily and those are getting tangled!
This plant's properties can be used for many applications!
I knew that you were knowledgeable but your ability is more than that!
I will tell the outcome to the Alchemist Union.
I will send a recommendation letter saying that your ability is really great and that you could be a brilliant member.
Getting an answer from the Union will take some time, so could you wait a moment?
Why don't you go up to Demi Calberine?
She is a fellow Geneticist, specializing in mini cannons.
Go take a look at her experiment results.
Could you give this message to her? Tell her to conduct her experiments quietly.
It didn't grow at all, it's withered already.
It seems that the mail's has arrived.
You can take a look at the Demi Calberine's work place while we get an answer from the Union.
I've got good news for you!
Oh, it looks like you're not ready to hear it.
First take off that heavy and dirty cart, that doesn't suit you on this happy moment.
But you look like you have a lingering desire for previous studies.
A letter has arrived from the Alchemist Union.
I'll read it to you, Popo!
<We are very aware of the brilliant activities you've shown lately.>
This guy is also from my hometown.
<I heard very good news that your research results are taking the step of commercial use.>
<I'm sure it will be a great inspiration for other Alchemists.>
<Come to think of it, you've attached a paper?>
<It was a new plant which makes plants grow super-fast, discovered by an Alchemist named, {0}>
<Myself and many other Alchemists from the Alchemist union are taking great interest in this.>
<We are looking forward to more volumes of study papers and outcomes, especially from other Geneticists who?ve heard this news.>
<I think that {0} has enough ability and talent to be a Geneticist.>
<Please tell {0} as soon as possible that we are expecting remarkable activities as a Geneticist from now on.>
<The Alchemist Union is very proud of Miss Devries, Miss Demi Calberine and {0} who are excellent talented people.>
<We hope that you yield good fruits in the future as well.>
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
You are a Geneticist from now on!!
Just like the word from the Union, I'm also looking forward to your awesome activities.
Let's try hard together! To become the best Geneticist!
Popo, do you want to join my Love Orleans club? It's a club for those that love cookies. Of course, we don't think of doing weird things with Charles Orleans.
Am I that pretty to you? Why are you staring at me like that?
- There are several cookie bags which are packed carefully in the box. -
- You've taken out a cookie bag out of the box. -
...Using animals in Alchemy can easily be practiced by anyone.
You can put the animals that you want to use on the white tray, imagine the goal you want to make and then practice the alchemy.
...The animals that are used in Alchemy might in the danger of getting extinct because of being captured by thoughtless alchemists.
...The guide of Alchemy using plants is easy to follow, even for a little kid.
You can put the plants on the table, and break or cut them, connect them using a simple tool, then do alchemy.

...The plants usually used for Alchemy are Bigibigi Grass and Muka Trees that have sharp thorns but are delicate inside and Bogi Creeper whose growth speed is really fast but parasitic on living things.
...Using minerals in Alchemy is a way that beginners find pretty easy.
You can put the minerals you want to in the beautifully crafted box, and sing any song that you can think of twice and then practice the alchemy.
...A mineral that's usually used for Alchemy is 'Phracon' which doesn't cost a lot.
...Alchemy is the easiest thing in the world.
This writer shows a cobalt blue Alchemy demonstration in front of students every week, and always get a big applaud from them.
I'm sure that you would be into the Alchemy world at the moment you read this book.
- This plant doesn't look suitable as an experiment sample. -
Information related to this plant can be found in the Plant Guide in the cabinet.
- This is a testing table with a lot of equipment. I think I can study the combinations here with plants. -
- It's not the time to start an experiment. -
Hmm, I need to gather plant materials first.
What shall I do with these plant materials?
Put it into a Testing Flask and Shake.
Inject it into a testing seed.
What kind of seed should I pick?
I've put the prepared materials into the chosen testing seed.
Good. Now I can let Miss Devries take a look at this seed!
- It looks like the experiment has failed. I better start over. -
- It looks like I need to let Miss Devries take a look at this seed! -
- This is a testing table with a lot of equipment. I think I can study the combinations here with plants. -
Why aren't their enough screws? Didn't I order new ones just recently?
When did you... Who are you?
I need to complete and ordered mini cannon today, but I can't find the parts!
Ugh~ I think they dropped around here somewhere.
I only need 10! I need to put the other parts together first... Please could you help me?!
Did you find the parts? No, not yet? You promised, please hurry up!
With this cart, the firepower won't do well, then let's put it in this way...
Oh, are these my lost screws and bolts?
You asked me to find them!
I don't even know where my mind is.
I will be done quickly with these.
Okay, I've connected the cannon to the cart... Now shall we test the performance?
Whew. You've been a lot of help to me.
Oh, by the way what made you come here?
Did you come here to order something
I heard that you were very knowledgeable about portable mini cannons and stuff.
Yep, I deal with many kinds of cannons.
Nowadays, there are those who want to remodel their carts, so I've been installing several additional functions such as mini cannons to their carts.
Yes, didn't you want to race out when you went downhill?
Or haven't you ever thought that it was so boring dragging around that plain old cart?
Carts are no longer just a wagon for storage.
You could hang a cannon on a cart to make it help you boost your attack power.
Miss Devries seems to be studying childish experiments downstairs.
I don't understand why those research papers get so popular.
This is the smallest and the lightest cannon in the world.
This is what I made but isn?t this so cute? Yipee~
Can I get my cart remodeled?
Unfortunately, the cart remodeling is only allowed for Geneticists.
It's a rule from the Alchemist Union, so I can't help it.
You can be a Geneticist too!
And what's more, you can?t so the cart remodeling to just any cart.
It can only be done on quality certified carts that've been polished for a long time.
You should practice your cart skills whenever you have time until you become a Geneticist.
Till your muscles are dealing with your cart in powerful harmony and your cart moves beautifully,
If you want, ^FF0000I'll show you a good training spot.^000000
^FF0000Devries won't like it much^000000, but it's the best place. Haha.
How about you swing your cart around as practice?
When you swing your cart at least ^FF0000100^000000 times, you can get rid of stress and the cart will be polished up enough.
Well, I need to get to work for the next order.
Come and find me whenever you need training.
I'll help you out whenever you need your cart remodeled.
- What's this? I feel like the floor is missing somewhere. -
It seem Miss Devries found out that I put you in her spore pen.
It's funny when you look at her face. After you've killed all those spores.
Do you want to enter the spore pen?
Have fun swinging your cart around~
What a shame! I wanted to see Miss Devries's angry face.
It seem Miss Devries found out that I put you in her spore pen.
It's funny when you look at her face. After you've killed all those spores.
- There are so many scattered things on the floor that the lab is in chaos. -
- You found a little metal fragment. -
- I think I've gathered all of the parts. -
If you bully my spores, I'll scream!!!
- I'd better get out before I get caught by Miss Devries. -
- 'Monthly Bang!' magazines are piled up in disorder. -
- A checker patterned blanket set which looks like it was picked carefully is too good for this dirty bed. -

< Do you want to have my pretty room? Do you have enough zeny? Is there enough room? Run to the Lighthalzen Department Store right away and get the most high-end wall papers and interior accessories! >
< Luxurious candles that'll lighten up your room, a huge golden mirror that every lady owns, you cannot miss any of them! >
- It's a room that looks like a storehouse, thanks to so many parcels piled up in the room. -
